title: Group Fitness Class Passes: cancellation window, late-cancel fee, no-show fee and no-show credit forfeiture by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. For each class-credit pack tier, it states the advance-notice window inside which a cancellation is treated as late, the flat fee charged for a late cancellation, the flat fee charged for a no-show, and whether a no-show forfeits the credit already spent on the booking.

## Basis by tier
Each tier fixes the number of hours before a class's scheduled start inside which cancelling is treated as a late cancellation, the flat fee charged for a late cancellation, and the flat fee charged for failing to attend a booked class without cancelling. Each tier also fixes whether a no-show, in addition to the fee, permanently forfeits the credit that was spent at booking rather than having it restored.

| Tier | Cancellation window (hours) | Late-cancel fee (USD) | No-show fee (USD) | No-show forfeits credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5-Class Pack | 12 | 5.00 | 15.00 | Yes |
| 10-Class Pack | 12 | 5.00 | 15.00 | Yes |
| 20-Class Pack | 8 | 5.00 | 15.00 | Yes |
| Unlimited Monthly Classes | 6 | 0 | 10.00 | No |
| Specialty Studio Pack | 24 | 10.00 | 25.00 | Yes |
| Founding Class Pass | 12 | 0 | 10.00 | Yes |

## Points of judgement
- Unlimited Monthly Classes and Founding Class Pass charge no late-cancel fee (0), while every other tier charges one.
- Unlimited Monthly Classes is the only tier where a no-show does not forfeit the credit — since that tier's credits are not finite in the first place, this setting governs whether a restorable-credit accounting applies rather than a literal credit count.
- The Specialty Studio Pack has both the widest cancellation window (24 hours) and the highest late-cancel and no-show fees of any tier, consistent with its master-instructor, specialty-only positioning.
